title: Life Insurance
description: Life Insurance Plugin For inventory/xp Player Save With Vault Economy
body:
## 🛡️ LifeInsurance

**LifeInsurance** allows players to protect their inventory on death by purchasing a one-time life insurance. Simple, lightweight, and fully configurable.

### ✨ Features

* 🧾 **Buy insurance via GUI**
* 💰 **Vault economy support**
* 🛡️ **Keeps inventory & XP on death**
* ⏳ **Time-limited insurance**
* 📊 **/insurance status command**
* 💾 **Persistent data (survives restarts)**
* ⚙️ **Fully configurable (price, duration, GUI)**

**Optional Kill Skull Feature :**

⚰️ When a player is killed by another player and kill-skull is enabled in config:

Drops the victim’s player head at the death location.
Head displays the victim’s name.

### 🧠 How it works

1. Player opens the insurance GUI (`insurance`)
2. Pays the configured price
3. Insurance stays active for a limited time
4. On death → inventory & XP are saved
5. Insurance is **consumed after use**

### 📜 Commands

* `/insurance` – Buy Insurance, Check insurance status & remaining time

### ⚙️ Requirements

* **Paper / Spigot / Purpur**
* **Minecraft 1.17.1 – 1.21.1**
* **Java 17+**
* **Vault** + any economy plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)

### 🛠️ Configuration

* Insurance price
* Insurance duration
* GUI title, item, lore
* All messages color-code friendly

### 🎯 Perfect for

* Survival servers
* Semi-hardcore gameplay
* Economy-based servers
* PvE & casual servers
